study_summary.objective: Evaluate the role of the transcription factor HacA in coping with ER stress and as a possible regulator of the unfolded protein response in A. oryzae (from the BioProject text).
study_summary.experimental_design: RNA-seq of the parent niaD300, a hacA knockout (HacA-DE, hacA replaced by a pyrG cassette) and a constitutively active hacA strain (HacA-CA, spliced hacA at the hacA locus); one library each, culture conditions not stated.
study_summary.main_finding: Not available: no accession-linked paper was found, so no result is reported here.

parent strain for the hacA mutants

notes: Medium, temperature, time and whether ER stress was applied are not stated in the BioProject or BioSamples, so no culture or stress tags were assigned.
